author: TortouseMincer
body:
Hey guys,


We all know a friend who's been banned, and the appeal may take quite some time.

Or sometimes it's not appealed, because why should we unban them if they don't contribute to the server?

Well, what if you did "Community Service" as a punishment or way to get appealed.

For instance, building maps, uplifting the forum community or maybe making a shop or something eg. Evocal's Skin shop. Maybe even making Avicus Videos etc. (Positive ones)

Anyone perm-banned must then contribute to the community in order to get unbanned :D
Not only will it help the good people who were banned that want an unban but it will also uplift our ameshinggg community :D

Leave suggestions if you want xD


Edit: Scrap the whole idea above xD Well kind of. Let me turn over the flip side of the coin. :D Instead of it making your ban easier to get removed; any person wanting an unban that has admitted guilty to hacking should do a few major contributions by making maps, YouTube etc.

Instead of just unbanning them; the server gains something. :D

replies.body:
I do agree, but people also make mistakes :3

You shouldn't automatically be unbanned, but it should be a way of showing you're sorry by dedicating time to the server. Perhaps people should do a lot of it as we also don't want people thinking they can be unbanned easily. 

People should abide to the rules, but some people don't realize what they've done :3
